task: Draft a go-to-market campaign for a new B2B SaaS product: an AI-powered expense-report auditor for mid-size finance teams. Budget is $50k/quarter, target is finance-ops managers at 200-2000 employee companies. Give: target-audience definition, positioning statement, 3 channel choices with budget split and why, and one key success metric per channel.
rubric: Score 0-1 on: (a) positioning is specific to finance-ops pain points, not generic AI hype; (b) channel choices are justified by where THIS audience actually is (not a copy-pasted generic B2C channel mix); (c) budget split is reasoned, not arbitrary; (d) each channel has a real, measurable success metric. A strong answer would fail (a) if it pitches 'save time with AI' without naming a concrete finance-ops workflow pain (e.g. manual receipt-matching, policy-violation detection).
